goal: Run the Android native release build for the current Nilaza mobile workspace, fix build-blocking configuration or environment issues that are safely in scope, and produce a checksummed local QA artifact with provenance.
successCriteria: The checked-in Android Gradle project completes :app:assembleRelease with the current Expo/RN configuration, or the report isolates an external environment blocker after documented repair attempts.
Any source/config edit is limited to native build inputs and is validated by TypeScript, mobile tests, embedded bundle checks, and the native build itself.
The resulting APK has verified package/version metadata, checksum, signing status, and a cold-launch/device smoke result.
No production deployment, store submission, Supabase migration, database repair, or credential changes are performed.
untouchedSurfaces: Tarot/content seed data, mobile product behavior, Supabase migrations, backend endpoints, admin workspaces, payment entitlements, and release publishing remain unchanged.
The production EAS profile, signing credentials, store metadata, and remote project configuration are not changed by this local build task.

impact.entryPoint: Android Gradle :app:assembleRelease from apps/mobile/android; the resulting APK is installed on the connected Air1_Ultra only for cold-launch and existing Tarot smoke verification.
impact.dataWrite: The build writes only local Gradle/build outputs and may preserve existing device app data during adb install -r; no user or backend data is created intentionally.
impact.backendContract: No backend contract changes. Offline/local fallback remains the safe device path if the installed APK is run without a configured backend.
impact.adminVisibility: No admin surface changes; the release manifest records sanitized source, version, checksum, signing, and device evidence only.
impact.privacySafety: No credentials, auth tokens, private journal content, or backend payloads are captured. The APK remains debug-signed QA output unless a separate release signing gate is satisfied.
impact.observability: Record Gradle task result, version/build code, APK checksum, signing verification, package metadata, device serial/model, and cold-launch result.
impact.rollback: Delete or ignore the generated local APK/manifest and revert only a scoped Gradle configuration edit if one is required; no database or remote rollback is needed.
impact.surfacesIntentionallyUntouched: Product UI, data contracts, migrations, backend, admin, store publishing, EAS credentials, and production signing are outside this task.
impact.agentHandoff: The native release build agent owns Gradle diagnosis, minimal native config repair, artifact provenance, and device smoke evidence, then stops at the local release-readiness recommendation.

canonicalContracts: docs/MOBILE_EAS_TESTING.md defines the local native build, internal QA versus release artifact boundary, and device acceptance rules.
docs/MOBILE_CI_OWNER_GUIDE.md defines the automated mobile quality baseline and release evidence requirements.
apps/mobile/app.json and apps/mobile/eas.json are the canonical package/version/profile inputs for this build.

sourceReview.reason: Reviewed Nilaza release boundary, native QA rules, migration stop condition, and no-secret guardrails.
Routed the task to mobile release readiness and native Android verification paths.
Applied the required impact map, preflight, validation, rollback, and release provenance gate.
Reviewed JDK/SDK/Gradle native build instructions and internal QA versus store release requirements.
Reviewed Mobile quality baseline, manifest expectations, and manager device acceptance gate.
Reviewed Android package, versionCode/version, new architecture, assets, and Expo native plugins.
Reviewed preview/production build profile separation and publishing boundary.
Reviewed Expo, React Native, Reanimated, and test versions used by the native project.
Reviewed Android SDK, NDK, Hermes, New Architecture, packaging, and Gradle settings before repair.
Reviewed React Native/Expo autolinking and monorepo dependency resolution.
Reviewed Android Gradle Plugin, Kotlin, SDK, NDK, and repository versions.
Reviewed native application ID, release signing, React Native bundle root, Hermes, and packaging inputs.

skillReview.name: nilaza-plan-qc
skillReview.evidence: Applied the native build impact map, preflight, artifact provenance, device smoke, rollback, and release boundary requirements.

dependencyReview.evidence: The build uses checked-in Gradle files, installed node_modules, the Gradle wrapper, local Android SDK/JDK, and repository release guidance only.

securityReview.authzRls: No auth, authorization, RLS, endpoint, or migration behavior changes are planned.
securityReview.sensitiveData: Only sanitized build and device metadata are recorded; no private app data is used.
securityReview.secretsLogging: Do not print keystore passwords, tokens, public environment values containing secrets, or full environment dumps.
securityReview.externalInput: Gradle/npm dependencies are existing project inputs; no new package or remote script is introduced.
securityReview.dependencies: No dependency install or version upgrade is required for the repair; if a missing tool is found, stop and report it rather than changing the lockfile.
securityReview.migrationRelease: No database repair, push, deployment, store upload, EAS production build, or signing credential change is allowed in this task.
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop if the build requires a production secret, migration mutation, destructive clean/reset, dependency upgrade, or an unreviewed native architecture change.

workingTreeReview.note: The workspace contains prior Nilaza changes and existing local native build outputs. Preserve unrelated changes; only the listed native inputs, generated artifact metadata, and report belong to this task.

validationCommands: adb devices, adb install -r, apksigner verify, and cold-launch smoke on Q88549EEXCUOONGA
managerTestPath: Review the manifest next to the APK, install it with adb -r on Air1_Ultra, cold-launch app.nilaza.mobile without Metro, verify Home/Explore/Tarot artwork and the previously approved Tarot smoke path, then compare the version and checksum with the report.
residualRisk: A locally debug-signed APK is not a store release. Production signing, EAS credentials, CI provenance, store metadata, backend staging, and migration reconciliation remain separate gates.
